card.name: Kidney harm wording in NSAID pregnancy warnings
card.fires_on: The word "dysfunction" right after "fetal renal" in NSAID pregnancy warnings. It also fires weakly on words that follow "renal function" or "resulted in" in kidney-harm statements.

modes.label: Fetal renal dysfunction
modes.description: The word dysfunction after "fetal renal" in the NSAID warning about use at 20 weeks gestation or later.
modes.example: Use of NSAIDs at about 20 weeks gestation or later in pregnancy may cause fetal renal<< dysfunction>> leading to oligohydramnios

modes.label: Other renal harm phrases
modes.description: Punctuation or linking words inside NSAID kidney warnings, such as a comma after renal function or "in" before renal papillary necrosis.
